title: A novel polymer composite from polyhexamethylene guanidine hydrochloride for high performance triboelectric nanogenerators (TENGs)
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,844-850
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07768G, Paper
Open Access

Doan T. Tung, Le T. T. Tam, Nguyen T. T. Duong, Hoang T. Dung, Ngo T. Dung, Nguyen A. Duc, Phan N. Hong, Nguyen T. Dung, Phan N. Minh, Le T. Lu
A novel TENG with a 3D-printed PHMG-GA-PVA polymer composite film as a positive electrodes exhibits high output efficiency, remarkable durability and antibacterial properties, making it ideal for advanced energy-harvesting applications.
